incident.title: Webhook deliveries time out after client cleanup
incident.description: Outbound webhook success fell from 99% to 61% immediately after a client-library cleanup. Provider dashboards are healthy and failures cluster at exactly two seconds.

evidence.content: {"sha":"a101010101010101010101010101010101010101","message":"Centralize outbound HTTP client; set default timeout to 2s and remove webhook override","author":"lee","timestamp":"2026-08-06T06:52:00Z"}
Webhook providers may respond in up to eight seconds. A sharp failure boundary at one configured duration usually indicates a client-side timeout rather than provider saturation.

ground_truth: The shared HTTP client removed the webhook-specific timeout and imposed an insufficient two-second default.

incident.title: Tenant users intermittently see another tenant's feature flags
incident.description: Feature-flag responses are valid but occasionally belong to the previous tenant handled by the same application instance. The issue began after a caching optimization.

evidence.content: {"number":611,"title":"Cache feature flag documents","description":"Use environment name as the cache key because flag names are globally consistent. Tenant is resolved after the cache lookup.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-06T07:42:00Z"}
Every cache entry carrying tenant data must include tenant_id in its key. Authorization after retrieval cannot undo cross-tenant cache contamination.

ground_truth: PR 611 omitted tenant_id from the feature-flag cache key, allowing cross-tenant cache reuse.

incident.title: OAuth token exchange fails only in production
incident.description: OAuth callbacks reach the service, but token exchange returns invalid_client in production. Staging remains healthy and the provider reports no outage.

evidence.content: {"sha":"b201010101010101010101010101010101010101","message":"Read OAuth secret from mounted file without stripping trailing whitespace","author":"ivy","timestamp":"2026-08-06T08:12:00Z"}
Mounted secret files commonly end with a newline. Normalize surrounding whitespace before using a file-backed OAuth client secret and compare byte lengths, never secret values, in diagnostics.

ground_truth: The production mounted secret included a trailing newline that the new loader did not strip.

incident.title: Some invoice emails disappear during worker restarts
incident.description: Invoice jobs are marked complete, but a small number produce no email when workers restart. There are no retries for the missing deliveries.

evidence.content: {"sha":"c301010101010101010101010101010101010101","message":"Acknowledge invoice job before sending email to shorten queue lease","author":"noor","timestamp":"2026-08-06T08:36:00Z"}
A durable job is completed only after its side effect succeeds. Acknowledging first converts worker termination into silent message loss.

ground_truth: The worker acknowledged jobs before email delivery, so termination caused unrecoverable job loss.

incident.title: Requests alternate between old and new tax behavior
incident.description: After a blue-green release, otherwise identical requests alternate between two tax rounding rules. Both deployment colors are receiving traffic.

evidence.content: {"number":623,"title":"Make tax rounding configurable","description":"Add TAX_ROUNDING_MODE to the green deployment template only; blue retains the previous default.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-06T09:05:00Z"}
Blue-green colors must receive identical runtime configuration before shared traffic. Alternating deterministic behavior is evidence of configuration skew between colors.

ground_truth: PR 623 configured only the green color, leaving blue and green with different rounding modes.

incident.title: Reporting reads fail while writes remain healthy
incident.description: The reporting endpoint began returning missing-column errors after a release. Primary writes succeed, but reports use a read replica.

evidence.content: {"sha":"d401010101010101010101010101010101010101","message":"Query invoices.tax_region in reports; migration job targets primary connection only","author":"zoe","timestamp":"2026-08-06T09:48:00Z"}
When reads and writes use different database targets, verify schema migration visibility on every target before deploying code that reads a new column.

ground_truth: The report queried a column whose migration was applied only to the primary target, not the reporting replica.

incident.title: Checkout stalls under modest concurrency
incident.description: Checkout latency jumps to 30 seconds at only twenty concurrent requests. CPU is low, database query time is normal, and connection wait time dominates.

evidence.content: {"number":637,"title":"Audit checkout transactions","description":"Open a transaction before calling the fraud service and keep the connection until the remote response returns.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-06T10:02:00Z"}
Checkout must not hold a database transaction or pooled connection across network calls. Remote latency then consumes the connection pool even when query latency and CPU remain low.

ground_truth: PR 637 held database connections across a fraud-service network call, starving the checkout pool.
